titles.native: ステージ・バイ・ステージ

description: The fourth anime project by Pachinko & Slot Parlor Akiba Island. Taking place a short time after Devidol!, where Aira, Shima and Hana have already become top idols, Stage by Stage will follow three girls with different backgrounds and upbringings, though all admirers of our lovable Devil Idols, as they grow up day by day as virtual idols.
